{{Quote|We need, say, a "Red Team" to ambush the Imperials that come out after the force field is lowered.|[[Tai Cordan]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
During the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]], the '''"Red Team"''' of the [[Rift Alliance]] consisting of [[Gaden-Ko]]'s [[Voss commandos]] ambushed the Imperial scouts after [[the Barsen'thor]] disabled enemy sensors in the vicinity of [[Guardian Hold Four]], causing the Imperials occupying the Hold to lower the force field and send teams to investigate.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|As Above, So Below|Corellia}}</ref>
